last_error.description: Error from the most recent fetch attempt, if it failed (cached content is still used).

allowed_clients.description: CIDRs of clients allowed to use the proxy.

allowed_destinations.description: CIDR exceptions to the destination refusals.

available.description: False until the filter engine feeds the buffer (see docs/API.md).

Scope.description: A fine-grained permission, written `resource:action` on the wire.

current.description: True for the session making this request.

source_url.description: Page the request originates from (defaults to the URL itself).

UpdateCustomRulesRequest.description: Replace the user's custom filter rules.

UpdateProxyConfigRequest.description:
Partial proxy configuration update. Every field is optional; omitted fields
are left unchanged.

allowed_clients.description: CIDR list; replaces the current one. Needs a restart.

allowed_destinations.description: CIDR list; replaces the current one. Needs a restart.

tls_passthrough_hosts.description: Replaces the TLS passthrough host list. Needs a restart.

transparent_port.description: Transparent listener port; `0` turns it off. Needs a restart.

restart_required.description: Fields saved to the config file that only apply after a restart.

UpdateProxyConfigResponse.description:
Result of a config update: the new config plus which changes are already live and which
need a restart.

UserInfo.description:
Safe user info (no sensitive data). `id`/`created_at`/`last_login` are wire
strings (UUID / RFC 3339).

scopes.description: Effective scopes granted by the role.

lines.description: Comments and blank lines are skipped; every other line appears here.

bearer_auth.description: Personal API token: `Authorization: Bearer abk_<id>_<secret>`. Create one with POST /tokens. Per-operation scopes are listed in `x-scopes`.

cookie_auth.description: Session cookie from POST /auth/login. Unsafe methods must also send the `X-CSRF-Token` header (value of the `csrf_token` cookie).
cookie_auth.name: access_token

x-scopes.ca:read: Read CA certificate details (fingerprint, expiry, subject).
x-scopes.config:write: Change or reload the proxy configuration.
x-scopes.engine:reload: Trigger a rebuild of the blocking engine.
x-scopes.lists:read: View filter lists, their status and the update schedule.
x-scopes.lists:write: Add, edit, remove and refresh filter lists; change the update schedule.
x-scopes.rules:read: Read custom rules; validate rules and test URLs against the engine (no changes).
x-scopes.scripts:write: Install, update, enable, disable and remove userscripts.
x-scopes.sessions:admin: List and revoke any user's sessions.
x-scopes.sessions:self: Log out, change your password, list and revoke your own sessions.
x-scopes.stats:read: Read blocking, proxy and engine statistics.
x-scopes.system:read: Read system status and metrics (JSON and Prometheus).
x-scopes.tokens:admin: List and revoke any user's API tokens.
x-scopes.tokens:self: Create, list and revoke your own API tokens.
x-scopes.users:admin: Create, update, disable and delete user accounts.
